title: Careers — Content

fields.message: Careers — one tab per section. Edits fill that section's {{slots}} on the live page. Shortcode attributes still override, and a blank field falls back to the built-in default.

fields.label: Headline
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_heading
fields.instructions: The hero display headline. Approved editable by Sean 2026-08-13. LENGTH IS A HINT, NOT A LIMIT — under ~50 characters keeps it to 3 lines at 1440, but character count is only a proxy because WORD length drives the break: careers-hero renders 4 lines at 42 characters where community-hero renders 3 at 43, same rule and same width. 4 lines is the practical ceiling; at ~70 characters the headline is 5 lines and consumes the whole fold, pushing the next section off-screen. Measured, not guessed. The hero doodles were pinned to the padding band first (b324b35) so a longer headline can no longer drag one into the type — before that fix the top mark fell 43px between a 3-line and a 5-line headline and ended up level with the first line. NOTE this headline STARTS a line closer to the ceiling than the other three — it is already 4 lines at its current 42 characters, so it has roughly one line of headroom rather than two.
fields.default_value: Come work somewhere you actually want to be

fields.label: Sub copy — before the highlight
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_sub_1
fields.instructions: Everything up to and including the em dash. The space before the highlight is in the markup, so no trailing space here.
fields.default_value: We're building careers here, not just filling shifts. If you're driven, hospitality-minded, and ready to grow —

fields.label: Sub copy — highlighted phrase
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_sub_highlight
fields.instructions: Sits in the yellow marker block that closes the sentence. Short — it is a highlight, not a clause.

fields.label: Highlight animation
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_hl_variant
fields.instructions: How the marker highlight behind the sub copy arrives. h3 (default) rough hand-drawn block + ~5deg angled wipe, closest to the comps. h1 background wipe — THE ONLY ONE THAT SURVIVES A LINE WRAP; switch to it if you lengthen 'Sub highlight' enough to reflow, because h3's block is one rigid shape that cannot wrap with the text. h0 static, no animation. Unknown or blank renders a static painted mark, never blank. Catalogue: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Underline animation
fields.name: brg_careers_hero_uline_variant
fields.instructions: How the hand-drawn underline (line-careers-lg.svg) reveals. u3 (default) filled brush + ~5deg angled wipe, keeps the taper. wipe straight-edged reveal, the conservative fallback. u1 scaleX bar — this is what this hero used BEFORE the artwork swap, kept so the old look can be compared live. Unknown or blank renders the mark static and visible, never hidden. Catalogue: website/lab/README.md.

fields.label: Body copy — first paragraph
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_body_1
fields.instructions: Left column, opening paragraph. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write an em dash as a literal —, not —.
fields.default_value: This isn't your average restaurant gig. At BRG, we invest in our people — with real training, real growth paths, and a culture that actually lives up to the hype.

fields.label: Body copy — second paragraph
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_body_2
fields.instructions: Left column, second paragraph. The two paragraphs are separate fields because the two-paragraph break is layout, not content.
fields.default_value: Whether you're starting your first job in hospitality or you're a seasoned operator looking for your next move, there's a place for you here. We promote from within, develop leaders intentionally, and build teams that stick around.

fields.label: Right column heading
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_offers_heading
fields.instructions: Sits above the asterisk-bulleted list. Short — it renders in the display face at up to 2.2rem, so ~14 characters keeps it on one line. The list items themselves are not editable; they are code.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_cta_label
fields.instructions: Black-bordered button at the foot of the section. ~18 characters.

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: brg_careers_apply_cta_href
fields.instructions: Defaults to the in-page anchor for the open-positions section below. A full URL works too.

fields.label: Heading
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_heading
fields.instructions: Display face on the yellow band, up to ~3.5rem. Wraps freely. ~30 characters keeps it to two lines.

fields.label: Sub copy
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_sub
fields.instructions: One line beneath the heading. Plain text; markup is escaped. Write & and — as literal characters.
fields.default_value: Browse our open roles below — from front-of-house to leadership positions across Board & Brew and Odie's Pizza Co.

fields.label: Button label
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_cta_label
fields.instructions: Black button on the yellow band. ~18 characters.

fields.label: Button link
fields.name: brg_careers_positions_cta_href
fields.instructions: Defaults to the in-page anchor for the roles list.

description: Editable content for the Careers page, one tab per section. Generated — edit website/sections/<id>/slots.json and rerun kit/build-acf.py.
